subject: On‑prem licensing & support tiers — commercial proposal follow‑up
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire O'Neal <claire.oneal@fintect.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-18T14:12:00Z
Subject: On-prem licensing & support tiers — initial commercial summary

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for the meeting this morning. As promised, attaching a concise commercial summary for Fintect's on‑prem / VPC deployment (attachment: Redwood_Private_Pricing_Proposal_v3.pdf). Key points up front:

- License: perpetual runtime license for on‑prem deployment + annual platform fee. Example: $500k one‑time license + $120k/yr platform fee for baseline capacity (up to 8 GPUs equivalent).
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 12x5), Premium (24x7 with 1‑hour P1 response), and Enterprise (dedicated TAM, custom SLAs).
- Discounts: volume / multi‑year commitments and pilot credits available. For a 3‑year committed contract we typically provide a 12–18% discount on platform fees and license amortization.

A few open questions from your finance/procurement list so we can lock a final quote:
1) Do you prefer quoting as a capital purchase (one‑time license + annual support) or as a 3‑year amortized subscription?
2) Any minimum SLA requirement for mean time to recovery or uptime?
3) Is there a preferred signing authority / procurement contact for PO routing and tax info?

If you want, Monica can put together a side‑by‑side of the three support tiers with clear deliverables.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]
(415) 555-0182

Attachment: Redwood_Private_Pricing_Proposal_v3.pdf
From: Claire O'Neal <claire.oneal@fintect.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Fintect Solutions Procurement <procure@fintect.com>, Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@fintect.com>
Date: 2026-01-19T09:07:00Z
Subject: Re: On-prem licensing & support tiers — initial commercial summary

Jordan,

Thanks — the deck is helpful. A few clarifications from procurement and our CTO:

- Procurement is leaning toward capital purchase but wants an optional 3‑year amortized schedule for comparison.
- Our primary ask is a 99.9% availability SLA for the control plane and 24x7 support during business critical windows (we have batch windows overnight). Premium or Enterprise tiers likely required.
- Budget range: we were expecting OPEX ~ $90k/yr for platform fees (we know that’s below your baseline). Any flexibility on platform fee with a 3‑year commitment?

Also, procurement asked if you can provide a redline‑friendly MSA and an onboarding SOW with timelines. Ravi will be our procurement lead on this — copying him.

Claire O'Neal
VP Product, Fintect Solutions
claire.oneal@fintect.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire O'Neal <claire.oneal@fintect.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-19T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: On-prem licensing & support tiers — initial commercial summary

Claire — appreciate the transparency. Quick answers and an optional commercial pathway: 

1) Pricing pathways we can provide:
   - CAPEX: One‑time license + annual platform fee (baseline example in the deck).
   - 3‑year amortized subscription: Spread license over 36 months and include a slightly larger discount on platform fees.

2) SLA: We can commit to 99.9% control plane availability on Enterprise with a 4‑hour P1 response in Premium and 1‑hour in Enterprise (we can provide credits for missed targets).

3) Budget / flexibility: Given Fintect is targeting $90k/yr OPEX, we can propose a blended pathway for a 3‑year deal:
   - Amortized license equivalent + platform fee = ~$450k/year all‑in (this is illustrative).
   - For a 3‑year committed term we can discount platform fees by 20% and provide a $60k onboarding credit (applied year 1). That should get the effective year‑one OPEX closer to your target depending on amortization preference.

I’m attaching an SOW template and a redline‑friendly MSA for your legal team to review. Monica — could you produce the formal tiered table and a short TCO comparison (CAPEX vs 3‑yr) so we can send a single commercial offer?

If procurement wants, we can also run an adjusted pricing scenario that constrains support to Premium only for the first year and upgrades later.

Best,
Jordan

Attachments: SOW_Onboarding_Fintect.docx; Redwood_MSA_Redline.docx
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Claire O'Neal <claire.oneal@fintect.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-20T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: On-prem licensing & support tiers — formal tier table and TCO

Hi Claire, Jordan — attached is the Support_Tiers_TCO.xlsx extract (pasted below and attached as a file in the PDF proposal):

Support tiers (summary):
- Standard: $0 (included w/license) — 12x5 support, 24‑hour P1 response, quarterly health checks.
- Premium: +$60k/yr — 24x7 support, 4‑hour P1, monthly operational reviews, access to SLA credits.
- Enterprise: +$120k/yr — 24x7, 1‑hour P1, dedicated TAM, weekly cadence during onboarding, custom runbook development.

Pricing scenarios (high level):
- CAPEX (one‑time): License $520k + Platform fee $120k/yr + Premium support $60k/yr.
- 3‑yr amortized (recommended for Fintect): Effective annual cost = (License amortized) $175k/yr + Platform fee $96k/yr (20% discount) + Premium $60k/yr = ~$331k/yr pre‑credits. Apply onboarding credit ($60k) in year 1 to get ~ $271k year‑one.

Notes:
- The onboarding credit is contingent on a signed 36‑month commitment and standard payment terms (Net 30).
- We can swap Premium for Enterprise if Fintect needs 1‑hour P1 out of the gate; that adds ~$60k/yr on top of Enterprise baseline above.

Please let me know which scenario you want formalized into a signature‑ready commercial summary and I’ll produce a redlineable quote (PDF) and updated SOW.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Claire O'Neal <claire.oneal@fintect.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Fintect Solutions Procurement <procure@fintect.com>, Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@fintect.com>
Date: 2026-01-21T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: On-prem licensing & support tiers — formal tier table and TCO

Jordan / Monica,

Thanks for the detailed options — this is helpful. Procurement and I reviewed internally and we're prepared to move forward with the 3‑year amortized pathway with Premium support, subject to:

- Finalized redline MSA (Ravi will push back on a couple of indemnity items).
- Onboarding timeline: we need production readiness within 8 weeks of PoS.
- Payment: prefer quarterly invoicing on the amortized schedule; will confirm with finance.

Please send a signature‑ready commercial summary (1‑page) reflecting the 3‑yr amortized numbers with the 20% platform discount and the $60k onboarding credit applied in year 1. Once we have that, procurement will route a PO and our legal team will start redlines on the MSA.

Claire
